"Return to me, says the Lord of hosts, and I will return to you." What does returning to God look like for you?
The Lord answered with "gracious and comforting words." What comforting words has God given you?
"I will be to her a wall of fire all around, and I will be the glory in her midst." How is God your protection?
"He who touches you touches the apple of his eye." What does this show about how God sees his people?
"Sing and rejoice... for behold, I come and I will dwell in your midst." What does God's coming to dwell mean?
Joshua's filthy garments were removed and he was clothed in clean ones. How does this picture what God does for you?
God will bring his servant the Branch. How does this point to Jesus?
"Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit, says the Lord of hosts." Where do you need to rely on God's Spirit?
"Who has despised the day of small things?" What small beginnings might God be using?
The flying scroll showed God's judgement on theft and lying. Why does God care about honesty?
Wickedness was carried far away. What does this show about God removing sin?
The man called the Branch will build the temple and be a priest on his throne. How does this point to Jesus?
"This shall come to pass, if you will diligently obey the voice of the Lord your God." What does God ask of you?
God asked, "When you fasted... was it for me that you fasted?" Why do you do what you do for God?
"Render true judgements, show kindness and mercy to one another, do not oppress the widow." How can you live this out?
Jerusalem shall be called the faithful city. What would make your community faithful?
"Speak the truth to one another... love no false oath." How can you be truthful this week?
Ten men will take hold of a Jew's robe, saying, "Let us go with you, for we have heard that God is with you." How might others see God with you?
"Your king is coming to you; righteous and having salvation is he, humble and mounted on a donkey." How did Jesus fulfil this?
"Return to your stronghold, O prisoners of hope." What does it mean to be a prisoner of hope?
"How great is his goodness, and how great his beauty!" What about God's goodness moves you?
"Ask rain from the Lord in the season of the spring rain." What do you need to ask God for?
The people wandered like sheep for lack of a shepherd. How does Jesus shepherd you?
"I will strengthen the house of Judah... I have compassion on them." What does God's compassion mean to you?
The shepherd was paid thirty pieces of silver. How does this point to Jesus' betrayal?
Woe to the worthless shepherd who deserts the flock. What does a good shepherd do?
The Lord will protect the inhabitants of Jerusalem so the feeblest will be like David. How does God strengthen the weak?
"They will look on me, on him whom they have pierced, and mourn." How does this point to Jesus' crucifixion?
"A fountain shall be opened... to cleanse them from sin and uncleanness." How has Jesus cleansed you?
"Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered." How did Jesus apply this to himself?
"They will call upon my name, and I will answer them. I will say, 'They are my people.'" What does belonging to God mean?
The Lord's feet will stand on the Mount of Olives. How does this connect with Jesus' return?
"The Lord will be king over all the earth. On that day the Lord will be one and his name one." What hope does this give?
Even ordinary pots will be holy to the Lord. How can ordinary life be holy?
